title: Joel Robuchon
description: LA PUREE DE POMMES DE JOEL ROBUCHON *
ingredients: Two pound small potatoes (in France the Ratte variety, fingerling shape) unpeeled
8 oz (250 g) butter, very cold (of course unsalted, and 82% minimum fat content)

1 cup (25 cl) whole milk, coarse sea salt (one tablespoon for 4 cups water) wash the potatoes, place in a pot, cover with cold water up to one inch above the potatoes, add the salt cook at a simmer for 30 minutes or until done, drain, peel while still warm

directions.h: bring the milk to a boil

directions: puree the potatoes through a traditional food mill, return to the pot and dry out, using a wooden spoon, for 2/3 minutes over low heat, add the butter, cut up in morsels, stirring it into the potatoes, then add the hot milk, a fine streak at the time, stirring with the wooden spoon. Using a whisk, make sure the puree is extremely smooth before serving
